evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 at 3.3 ppm after the purge brought it down to ~5 ppm
O2 at 23.3 ppm and still rising
O2 at 32.4 ppm, a steady climb during growth
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, matching setpoint, so a stuck MFC is unlikely
Pressure steady at ~760 Torr with no rise, which argues against an exhaust blockage
Temperature holds at 750 °C with normal heater power, so the thermocouple and heater look fine

args.missing_evidence: A leak check (isolate the tube and watch the pressure rise, or use a helium sniffer on the flanges and fittings) would confirm a seal leak. Reference O2 statistics for the growth stage were not provided.
